notes: S5-HVS1: included as follow_up because the paper analyzes the previously identified HVS candidate rather than newly identifying it; Koposov et al. (2020) is credited with its identification (T:p11-b1), and the paper discusses its extreme Galactocentric velocity (T:p12-b3).

S5-HVS1: S5-HVS1 is discussed as a previously identified HVS candidate (Koposov et al. 2020). The paper reports its Galactocentric velocity (1750 km/s) and an ejection velocity of v_ej ≈ 1800 km/s at 4.8 Myr ago, but does not report its equatorial coordinates, distance, parallax, proper motion, or heliocentric radial velocity. The ejection velocity is not a heliocentric/barycentric line-of-sight velocity, so it is not recorded as radial_velocity.
